data.title: Above the blue fjord
data.body: Two hours of climbing and every step was worth it. The water down there looks painted.

data.title: When the rocks catch fire
data.body: The last ten minutes of sunlight turned this whole ridge orange. No filter needed.

data.title: The road that disappears
data.body: Windows down, green cliffs on both sides and nowhere to be until tomorrow.

data.title: Standing still before the storm
data.body: The sky was moving faster than the waves. Sometimes you just stop and breathe it in.

data.title: Morning fog in black and white
data.body: The forest woke up slowly today. The mist did not lift until almost noon.

data.title: Coming in to land
data.body: Waited a long time for this one. Those wings are wider than I am tall.

data.title: Camping is hard, apparently
data.body: He lasted five minutes outside before demanding the good blanket.

data.title: Found the end of the rainbow
data.body: Soaked from head to toe within a minute, and I would do it again right now.

data.title: Our home for the night
data.body: Minus twelve outside, hot tea inside, and the quietest view I have ever had.

data.title: Greener than any photo can show
data.body: You can hear this waterfall long before the trees open up and let you see it.

data.title: A castle above the trees
data.body: It really does look like the page of a storybook, even on a cloudy afternoon.

data.title: Slow day by the river
data.body: Granite walls, tall pines and absolutely no phone signal. Exactly what I needed.
